Hello! My name is Jessica Rumkin, but I usually go by Jessi.

This site serves as a portfolio of my experience and skills. In the top navbar you can view my [general CV](Jessica_Rumkin_CV_general_2026.pdf){target="_blank"} explore my [projects](posts.qmd), see the [about page](about.qmd) to learn more about me, or even browse the source code on GitHub.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

I have a B.Sc. in Environmental Studies and a minor in Spatial Studies from University of California, Santa Barbara. My studies focused on ecological conservation and management, water resources, and spatial analysis with GIS.

Please see the contact links to reach me!
